parts.name: tube body

physics.Basic_description: White cylindrical plastic tube body with a smooth matte finish, forming the main container.
physics.Functional_description: Holds the lip gloss liquid product inside the assembly.
physics.Grasped_description: Grasp the cylindrical side surface firmly with parallel jaws to stabilize the object.
physics.reason: Standard injection-molded cosmetic container wall enclosing liquid volume.

parts.description: White cylindrical plastic tube body with a smooth matte finish, forming the main container.
parts.function: Holds the lip gloss liquid product inside the assembly.

parts.name: center band

physics.Basic_description: Thin ring at the opening of the tube, appearing as a distinct band in the segmentation.
physics.Functional_description: Acts as the sealing rim or thread interface for the cap assembly.
physics.Grasped_description: Too small and integrated to grasp independently; avoid targeting this specific ring.
physics.reason: Modeled as a solid structural ring or thickened rim feature in this scale.

parts.description: Thin ring at the opening of the tube, appearing as a distinct band in the segmentation.
parts.function: Acts as the sealing rim or thread interface for the cap assembly.

parts.name: gloss

physics.Basic_description: The viscous liquid product contained within the tube, visible at the opening interface.
physics.Functional_description: The consumable cosmetic substance intended for application.
physics.Grasped_description: Cannot be grasped directly; it is a fluid contained within the tube.
physics.reason: Liquid fills the internal cavity, behaving as a continuous mass rather than a thin shell.

parts.description: The viscous liquid product contained within the tube, visible at the opening interface.
parts.function: The consumable cosmetic substance intended for application.

parts.name: cap

physics.Basic_description: White cylindrical plastic cap with a smooth finish, matching the tube body diameter.
physics.Functional_description: Screws onto the tube to seal the product and serves as the handle for the applicator wand.
physics.Grasped_description: Grasp the cylindrical side surface to unscrew or remove the cap from the tube.
physics.reason: Hollow shell structure designed to fit over the tube neck and house the wand stem.

parts.description: White cylindrical plastic cap with a smooth finish, matching the tube body diameter.
parts.function: Screws onto the tube to seal the product and serves as the handle for the applicator wand.

parts.name: wand stem

physics.Basic_description: Thin, slender white plastic rod connecting the cap to the applicator tip.
physics.Functional_description: Transfers torque from the cap to the applicator and dips into the product reservoir.
physics.Grasped_description: Too thin and fragile to grasp safely; manipulation should occur via the cap or tube.
physics.reason: Solid extruded or molded plastic rod required for structural rigidity.

parts.description: Thin, slender white plastic rod connecting the cap to the applicator tip.
parts.function: Transfers torque from the cap to the applicator and dips into the product reservoir.

parts.name: doe foot tip

physics.Basic_description: Small, soft, angled applicator tip (doe-foot) attached to the end of the wand stem.
physics.Functional_description: Applies the lip gloss smoothly to the lips via its flocked or soft surface.
physics.Grasped_description: Do not grasp; the soft material would deform and contaminate the gripper.
physics.reason: Small molded elastomer component, effectively solid at this scale.

simulation.collision: CoACD convex decomposition of concave source collision meshes (relative tolerance 0.03–0.05)

collisionFilter.description: Self-contact excluded between directly connected rigid groups, including the fixed base; nonadjacent contacts retained

simulation.inertia: Source URDF link inertials; missing inertials use geometry-derived defaults (density 1000 kg/m³)
simulation.friction: Source URDF mu1 as sliding friction; torsional 0.005, rolling 0.0001
simulation.contact: MuJoCo soft contacts (solref 0.01 1); source restitution is displayed, not converted
simulation.material: Rigid bodies; Young’s modulus and Poisson ratio are annotations, not soft-body parameters

interaction.description: Switchable virtual joint damping and reflected armature for interactive inspection; source properties are unchanged.
interaction.rule: damping ≥ rated effort / rated speed; armature = 2% child subtree mass (slide) or 2% mass × collision radius² (hinge)
